issues.jp_before: 母[はは]{は|wa-topic}ベランダ{で|de-place}洗濯物[せんたくもの]{を|o-object}干[ほ]します。
issues.problem: 干す takes に for where the laundry ends up (ベランダに干す is the more natural choice), so the distractor に is correct.
issues.action: Replaced with a new de-place item: 父はいつもベランダでたばこを吸います (only で fits).

issues.jp_before: 日曜日[にちようび]、父[ちち]{は|wa-topic}庭[にわ]{で|de-place}野菜[やさい]{を|o-object}育[そだ]てています。
issues.problem: 'On Sundays' does not go with 育てている (growing vegetables is ongoing, not a weekly activity).
issues.action: Removed 日曜日; English now 'My father grows vegetables in the garden.' Distractors changed to が/を/へ.

issues.jp_before: ここ{で|de-place}靴[くつ]{を|o-object}脱[ぬ]いでください。
issues.problem: ここに靴を脱いでください (where the shoes are left) is also said, so the distractor に is acceptable.
issues.action: Rewrote as ここで写真を撮らないでください ('Please don't take photos here.').

issues.jp_before: お母[かあ]さん{は|wa-topic}今[いま]、台所[だいどころ]{で|de-place}何[なに]{を|o-object}していますか。
issues.problem: The sentence-final question particle か was not marked as a slot.

issues.jp_before: 昨日[きのう]、友[とも]だち{が|ga-subject}うち{で|de-place}晩[ばん]ごはん{を|o-object}食[た]べました。
issues.problem: 食べる was used 4 times in the file (the limit is 3), and the sentence was a little stilted.
issues.action: Rewrote as 昨日、友だちとうちでケーキを焼きました ('Yesterday I baked a cake at home with a friend.').

issues.jp_before: 雨[あめ]{の|no-possessive}日[ひ]{は|wa-topic}、洗濯物[せんたくもの]{を|o-object}部屋[へや]{の|no-possessive}中[なか]{で|de-place}干[ほ]します。
issues.problem: 干す also takes に (部屋の中に干す is natural), so the distractor に is correct.
issues.action: Replaced with 雨の日は、子どもたちと家の中で遊びます (f=4; only で fits).
